title: Aftermath and Wardrobe
author: Juniper Oyelaran
blurb: Isandro Okafor, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the demolition date arrives.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
